### Acceptance
<!-- Observable end-to-end acceptance criteria. -->

### Preflight before push
- [ ] Source/build inputs complete
- [ ] Generated projections regenerated from authority
- [ ] Package/repository preflight passes locally
- [ ] Relevant tests pass locally
- [ ] Deterministic rebuild leaves a clean tree
- [ ] Version/release authority and dependency pins are coherent

### Independent confirmation
- [ ] CI confirms the already-qualified candidate
- [ ] Runtime proof status is explicit
- [ ] Restart/readback/failure-safety proof explicit where applicable

### Lessons / prevention
- Unexpected finding:
- Root cause:
- Prevention action (generator / guardrail / test / governance):
- [ ] Predictable failure class is caught before push, or reason recorded

### Release-note projection
- User-visible change:
- Internal-only engineering lesson:
- Release-note category:
- [ ] Release notes/changelog generated or reconciled from this record

### Closure
CLOSED = implemented + integrated + persisted where applicable + validated + failure-safe + restart-safe + contract-complete + tested + diagnosable + runtime-proof status explicit.

> CI is independent confirmation. It is not the debugger.
